about_the_game:
About the Game

Tiny Terra Spaces is a cosy, slow-paced builder where you can create your own charming medieval island. Choose whether to design an island from scratch, expand on an existing one, or take on gentle challenges in hop mode to unlock new places. With cosy 3D buildings and a theme inspired by the beauty and history of Scotland, you can build at your own pace and enjoy the process of bringing your world to life.

                                                           Game modes

Play your way: relax, explore, or take on gentle challenges.

Tiny Terra Spaces offers two cosy modes to enjoy.

Sandbox Mode

Shape your perfect island at your own pace. Expand, decorate, and refine until it feels just right. Choose from a range of pre-designed island layouts or start fresh whenever inspiration strikes.

Island Hop Mode

Sail between unique islands, each with its own goals and charm. Grow bustling communities, create landmark buildings, and once you are ready, set off to discover the next adventure.

                                                              Features

Modest Beginnings
Start with a single tile and slowly grow your cosy island, choosing from a carefully crafted selection of charming buildings.

Interact with the Environment
Each island has its own terrain, animals, and biomes to discover. Take a closer look at your buildings, meet wandering NPCs, and spend time with the creatures that share your world.

Admire Your Creation
Zoom in to connect with your lively little community, watch villagers go about their day and see animals exploring the island.

Calming Music

Enjoy gentle, soothing melodies that set a cosy pace for your journey, keeping the game warm and relaxing throughout.

No Dangers, No Pressure
No enemies, no timers, no rush. Just a peaceful space to build your island at your own pace.

Gentle Resource Management
Each building has a cost, so you will need to keep an eye on your resources. But there is always enough flowing in to keep your island growing steadily.

A World to Treasure

Every island becomes its own little story, shaped by the buildings you place and the moments you enjoy along the way.
